name: record7 Gang Sheet Studio
author: 7rex

sections.description:
record7 Gang Sheet Studio gives print shops a complete basic workflow for accepting customer-created gang sheets.

Included features:

  • Configurable sheet sizes and prices.
  • JPG, JPEG, and PNG uploads.
  • Manual drag-and-drop artwork placement.
  • Proportional artwork resizing.
  • Delete selected artwork or clear the sheet.
  • Re-add an uploaded design manually.
  • Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile workspace.
  • Flattened PNG production-file generation.
  • WooCommerce cart and checkout integration.
  • Secure finished-file download from the WooCommerce order screen.
  • No required account, telemetry, percentage fee, or external billing service.

Use the shortcode:

[record7_gang_sheet_studio]

The separately distributed Pro edition adds Auto-Build nesting, exact quantities, Fill Remaining Space, rotation, duplication, multi-select, smart alignment, DPI reporting, and the complete production dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin, or copy the record7-gang-sheet-studio folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate record7 Gang Sheet Studio. The Pro edition is automatically deactivated if it is active.
  4. Open Gang Sheet Studio in wp-admin and review sheet sizes, prices, and checkout settings.
  5. Add [record7_gang_sheet_studio] to the customer-facing builder page.

The plugin can create a hidden WooCommerce product named Gang Sheet Print when no product is selected manually.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin functional without Pro?

Yes. Customers can upload multiple designs, manually arrange and resize them, create the flattened production PNG, and complete WooCommerce checkout.

How does the print shop download the finished file?

Open the WooCommerce order in wp-admin. A secure Download Finished Gang Sheet button appears below the gang-sheet line item.

Does this plugin report sales or usage to record7?

No. It contains no percentage billing, remote usage reporting, required account, or telemetry.

What is reserved for Pro?

Automatic nesting, quantity-driven layout, Fill Remaining Space, rotation, duplication, multi-select, smart alignment, DPI reporting, production statuses, notes, rush controls, reprints, and the advanced production dashboard.
sections.changelog:
1.9.1

  • Removes “Free” from the plugin name and directory-facing branding to follow WordPress.org naming guidance. 🙂
  • Keeps the existing manual builder, WooCommerce checkout, shortcode, settings, and Pro compatibility unchanged.

1.9.0

  • First dedicated WordPress.org edition.
  • Includes a complete manual builder and WooCommerce checkout workflow.
  • Adds secure finished-file downloads directly inside WooCommerce order administration.
  • Removes all Auto-Build, automatic packing, quantity, Fill Space, rotation, duplication, multi-select, smart-alignment, DPI, status, notes, rush, reprint, and advanced production-dashboard code.
  • Preserves the same shortcode, settings keys, product, and uploads used by Pro for easy switching.
  • Automatically deactivates Pro when this edition is activated.
  • Declares WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage compatibility.
